name: Grok 4.7
archDisplay: Proprietary sparse-MoE reasoning model (undisclosed size); 500K-token context
note: SpaceXAI's Sep 21, 2026 flagship, available the same day on the xAI API as grok-4.7, in Cursor and Grok Build, at Grok 4.6's unchanged $2/$6 per Mtok with a 500K context. The launch post says it uses a new, larger base model and a longer RL run weighted to multi-hour tasks. At xHigh effort its launch-table rows are CursorBench 4.0 46.3%, DeepSWE v1.1 71.0% (high effort), AA Briefcase v1.1 1,657, Terminal-Bench 4.0 37.6% and Harvey Legal Agent 19.6%, well ahead of Grok 4.6 High on every row but behind Fable 5.1 Max on most coding rows.
